description: March 28th was the final day of the forty day legislative session in Georgia. Legislators voted on proposals related to guns, the HOPE Grant Scholarship, ethics reform and the annual requirement, the state budget. Here is a summary of the legislative accomplishments by the General Assembly in 2013. ...
paid_for_by: sponsored by Republican Representative Chuck Martin of Alpharetta and passed through Spencer’s Fiscal and Budget Oversight Committee
title: 2013 General Assembly Session Legislative Review
